patch_description: The recommendation identifies the one structural lever never tested: placing a bilateral one-pole damper *between* the two RTS passes rather than as terminal polish. Rationale: the Q/4 (locally adaptive) refinement pass re-sharpens genuine corners that the damper rounds — its Kalman gain responds to real dynamics — while removed ripple stays removed. This decouples smoothness from the accuracy guard that caps smoothness at 0.50. Additionally, the terminal Whittaker polish is gated on substantial residual ripple (r_std > 0.3·sigma_r): polishing a clean output only adds lag and risk of trend loss. Alpha for the inter-pass damper is set ~0.70 (within the recommended 0.65–0.75 band), tuned from the pass-1 residual ripple scale.
